summary: Require matching checkpoint rules before ending a person excusal

replay.detail: No startup or request-time replay is added.

schema.detail: No database schema, registry, wire field or stored claim changes.

rules.detail: Current voter selection changes without changing the Rules14 digest, drop planning, retention, proof digests or canonical ordering. A runtime now resumes an excused writer only after coherent self-including seal/verification terms with its current rules digest; incompatible work remains retained. Upgrade members together to avoid older binaries selecting a different current voter roster. First verifications and certificates remain immutable.

compatibility.detail: Current participant/status/attention readers reject incompatible or incomplete checkpoint work as reentry evidence. Legacy standalone helper semantics remain available. Person-only checkpoint.excused authority is unchanged.

downtime.detail: Uses the normal binary restart; no extra restart, index construction or backfill is added.

manual.detail: A returning matching runtime follows ordinary certificate/manifest catch-up and publishes a coherent seal. No new operator action or person impersonation is needed.

recovery.detail: Older supported binaries may again interpret any stale checkpoint work as ending an excusal. No source rows, excusals or certificates are rewritten, and this change does not restore a trimmed checkpoint.
